description: This file defines the abstract base class 'Template' used by the Twig templating engine. It provides methods for template rendering, block management, parent/traits handling, and source context access, serving as an implementation detail for compiled templates.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: An abstract base class for compiled Twig templates, providing core methods for template rendering, block management, and inheritance handling.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Provides debug information about the template, such as line mappings.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source code and metadata of the template.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent template object if any.

methods.name: doGetParent
methods.description: Internal method to determine the parent template, can be overridden.

methods.name: isTraitable
methods.description: Indicates whether this template can be used as a trait.

methods.name: displayParentBlock
methods.description: Displays the parent block content.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Displays a specific block with context.

methods.name: renderParentBlock
methods.description: Renders the parent block as a string.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Renders a block as a string.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block exists.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Returns all block names defined in the template.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template instance from various input types.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Returns the current template instance.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Returns all blocks defined in the template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the template with the given context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template to a string.

methods.name: yield
methods.description: Generator method for template rendering with support for yields and error handling.

methods.name: yieldBlock
methods.description: Generator for rendering specific blocks, supports parent blocks and error handling.

methods.name: yieldParentBlock
methods.description: Generator for rendering parent blocks.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks if a macro method exists.

methods.name: getTemplateForMacro
methods.description: Finds the template instance that defines a macro.

methods.name: doDisplay
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement actual rendering logic.
